text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A visitor barrels into the prep room just before the Takarazuka Kinen is set to begin.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-A-Ayabeee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud, thud, thud!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto, of all times…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you okay? Does anything hurt?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: N-nooo! I-I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I can… I can stand up on my own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Uh… yes, I'm okay. Um…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You're so cool, Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You're really cool. You're also so smart, honest, calm… and strong.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I think you're pretty amazing. …I've always thought so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I… I don't really have any confidence. I'm clumsy and wimpy. I'm just no good in general… But that means I'm also no good at giving up.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I should just learn from my failures and move on, but instead I just keep trying and failing. I fail and fail and fail…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But it's not like I enjoy being so awful… I wanted to change.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I… I just…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wanted to be like Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wanted to, but I can't. I can't be anything like her…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But I never gave up!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Then, one day… Opera O called my name.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Right there, right after the spring Tenno Sho. She said she's been waiting all this time… just for me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: S-so, that's why…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Today… I have to beat you, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That way I can… I can… I can be Opera O's rival!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And… I really mean it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto has made her lengthy confession known.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Listening in complete silence, Admire Vega then gives a firm response.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Look, I know you're feeling very passionate right now, but I don't recall myself participating in any of that opera fanatic's ridiculous antics.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So if you're aiming to be her rival, go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But I'm not going to lose this race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Only a select few can participate in the Takarazuka Kinen. It's the spring Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …It's something she can be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yielding is not an option. I will win—that much is certain.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-all right… I mean, good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With each runner clinging to their hopes, the beginning of the race draws near.
